subject: Post-call recap & review timeline for Crestline Health compliance review
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Whitmore <sarah.whitmore@crestlinehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & compliance bundle (next steps and timeline)

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the items I said I would share: 

- Attached: Redwood_Compliance_Bundle_2027.pdf (contains our SOC 2 Type II summary, data flow diagram, retention and logs description).
- Attached: security-addendum-draft.docx (starting point if legal wants edits).

Action items we discussed:
1) Crestline security/legal to review the compliance bundle and let us know any questions or blockers.
2) If helpful, we can do a 30-min technical walkthrough next week to go through the KMS/HSM and network boundary details.
3) Procurement contact to confirm PO timing once legal is comfortable.

Proposed timeline from our side: we can reserve dedicated capacity for your pilot week of Apr 18 if we get a green light on the compliance review by Apr 1. If dates shift, tell us and we can adjust.

If there are specific names from your security team who should get the packet directly, I can send a targeted copy with the redacted items removed.

Thanks — I’ll check back in a few days, but please ping me if anything is unclear.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales – Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: Redwood_Compliance_Bundle_2027.pdf (PDF, 3.4MB); security-addendum-draft.docx (DOCX, 42KB)
From: Sarah Whitmore <sarah.whitmore@crestlinehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@crestlinehealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & compliance bundle (next steps and timeline)

Thanks Mina — appreciate the clear recap and the package. I skimmed the bundle this morning and shared it with our security and legal folks. A couple quick notes from their side: 

- Security is interested in a brief break-out on key management — specifically whether customers can manage keys (BYOK) or if Redwood uses a managed KMS. Can we confirm options?
- Legal asked for a starting SLA paragraph for the procurement team so they can include it in the PO.

Timeline: our goal is to get the security/legal review done by Friday Mar 19, but procurement may not generate a PO until the following week (Mar 22+) depending on internal approvals. I’ll loop in procurement on any updated docs.

Also: can you send the security-addendum-draft as a Word doc (if possible) so legal can redline?

Sarah
Sarah Whitmore
VP, IT & Security Operations
Crestline Health
sarah.whitmore@crestlinehealth.com

Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & compliance bundle (next steps and timeline)

Hey Sarah — quick follow to check whether the security/legal team had any questions after their review. I attached a Word copy of the addendum for easy redlines (security-addendum-draft.docx).

If helpful, we can do a short technical session focused only on key management and networking (15–20 min). Lauren (cc’d) can join to walk through encryption at rest and transit and outline our BYOK options vs. Redwood-managed KMS.

If procurement needs a one-line SLA statement for the PO, proposed text below that legal can use as a placeholder: 
"Redwood Inference will maintain 99.9% availability for the Dedicated inference service with standard maintenance windows and advance notice for scheduled downtime; credits and escalation contacts will be detailed in the final order."

Would you like me to schedule a 15-min call or send the redlined addendum back?

Thanks,
Mina

Attachments: security-addendum-draft.docx (DOCX, 45KB)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: updated addendum ready for Sarah

Mina — I made the edits to the addendum based on what Sarah flagged (BYOK options and a clearer SLA clause). I also added a short tech note about key rotation cadence and our HSM attestations — pulled that language from our compliance bundle. If you want, I can jump on the call and cover the KMS section.

I’ve saved the redline to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3CrestlineReview (internal).

— Lauren

From: Sarah Whitmore <sarah.whitmore@crestlinehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@crestlinehealth.com, legal@crestlinehealth.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & compliance bundle (next steps and timeline)

Hi Mina — thanks for the nudge and for sending the WORD version. Security/legal finished their review this morning; two small asks: 

1) Confirm whether Crestline can enable customer-controlled keys (BYOK) for Dedicated deployments — your note said it was possible but wants exact steps and timeframe.
2) Procurement asked if Redwood can accept a standard 60-day net on the PO — procurement@crestlinehealth.com is copied.

If you can confirm those two items, procurement is ready to issue the PO and we can lock the pilot slot for Apr 18. Would love a 15-min sync for the BYOK steps tomorrow (Wed) afternoon if you have availability.

Best,
Sarah
